manaNeeded: {W} if Children of Korlis is in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater if Children of Korlis is on top of your library.
description:
Cast Children of Korlis either from your hand by paying {W} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it.
When Children of Korlis dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Children of Korlis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Children of Korlis ability, causing you to gain life equal to the life you've lost this turn.
Repeat.
